title: Completion Date of a Certification Cycle — Occupancy and Residency Certification Servicing Manual
content:
**Article 1.** Under the Occupancy and Residency Certification product, a completed cycle's completion date is the cycle's anchor date where every completion limit is met, and the last signature's standing date otherwise.

**Article 2.** Every completion limit is met when a return notice and a latest contact are on file, the calendar days from the return date to the anchor date are no more than the return link limit, the calendar days from the anchor date to the latest contact are no more than the confirmation link limit, and the anchor date precedes the due date the profile shows by no more than the due-date window. An anchor date before the return date, or a latest contact before the anchor date, counts as zero days after it.

**Article 3.** Under the standard rule the anchor date is the last signature's standing date and the return link limit, the confirmation link limit and the due-date window are each zero days, so the cycle is certified as of the last signature's standing date.

**Article 4 — Records.**

- *Open cycle:* the certification year equal to the calendar year of the due date the profile shows.
- *Last signature:* the certification recorded on the profile under the open cycle with the latest standing date, with its channel and the form it was recorded from; the form's receipt date is the date that form was received, a form received before the signature's standing date counting as received on it.
- *Return notice:* the accepted return-home notice about the primary borrower received most recently, with the return date it states.
- *Latest contact:* the latest check-in recorded on the profile.
- Whole calendar months are counted as anniversaries of the day number, a month being complete only on the same day number of a later month. Where two records share the date a reading is ordered by, the one entered first is read.

## Article 2 as a checklist of conditions

| Condition | Met when |
|---|---|
| records on file | a return notice and a latest contact are both on file |
| return link | days from the return date to the anchor date (zero if the anchor date is earlier) do not exceed the return link limit |
| confirmation link | days from the anchor date to the latest contact (zero if the contact is earlier) do not exceed the confirmation link limit |
| due-date window | the anchor date is on or before the due date shown, by no more days than the due-date window |

*Hypothetical case on the standard terms.* The anchor date equals the last signature's standing date, so whichever limits are met the completion date is that standing date.
